about: SRD 5.2.1 equipment, magic items and spell scrolls with their prices, for the Mythastria market (sim/market.py). Built by tools/build_srd_market.py from the official SRD 5.2.1 PDF; CC-BY-4.0, see the SRD's attribution. Only SRD 5.2.1 content: anything else is the GM's homebrew.

rules.consumable: half the rarity value, except a Spell Scroll
rules.spell_scroll: double the scribing cost: Cantrip 30 GP, Level 1 50 GP, Level 2 200 GP, Level 3 300 GP, Level 4 2000 GP, Level 5 3000 GP, Level 6 20000 GP, Level 7 25000 GP, Level 8 30000 GP, Level 9 100000 GP
rules.made_from_equipment: the armor's or weapon's own cost is added
rules.selling: Equipment fetches half its cost when sold (SRD 5.2.1, Selling Equipment)
